messages:
maya (eng-platform): Heads-up — getting noisy alerts from the billing preview pipeline. Seems like sampling overlap between ingest-summary and final aggregator is triggering duplicate 'missing credits' alerts for a small set of tenants. noticed ~0.6% invoice delta on daily preview.
samir (metering): Ugh. Is this the sampling dedupe that shipped last week?
maya (eng-platform): I think it's related but not identical. The samples are overlapping across two windows when a request is late-arriving and the shard reassign kicks in. ingest-summary marks sample A, aggregator also samples same request in the next window => double-count in preview alerts.
luis (analytics): Can you paste the example tenant IDs? I can run a quick query against the raw events.
maya (eng-platform): Tenant t-33f2 and t-9b7e in PROD. repro steps: 1) request routed -> shard 4, delayed due to backpressure 2) shard revocation moves it -> ingest replays into window+1 3) both summary and aggregator count it.
samir (metering): If we have the same fingerprint/key for both windows we should dedupe before alerting. Our dedupe TTL is 60s but these late arrivals can be >90s. We either extend TTL or change key to include window id; both have tradeoffs.
ira (prodops): Extending TTL feels like a band-aid — it increases memory on the aggregator. Changing key sounds safer but might hide genuine duplicates. What's the cardinality impact?
luis (analytics): Quick numbers: for the last 24h those two tenants had ~3400 late events; only ~20 caused deltas. If we increase TTL to 180s memory increases ~3% on the consumer group for peak.
samir (metering): 3% is acceptable short-term. Alternative: add a cheap pre-check on the console that suppresses duplicate alerts if preview delta < threshold AND matching fingerprint exists in last N windows. That keeps pipeline unchanged but fixes UX noise.
maya (eng-platform): I like graceful suppression in console UX + medium-term fix in pipeline. Can someone prototype the console rule? Example heuristic: if invoice_preview_delta_pct < 0.5% and duplicate_fingerprint_count > 1 then don't fire alert; instead mark as 'low-confidence preview delta' with link to raw events.
ira (prodops): Works for ops. We need to make it visible in the dashboard so CS sees why preview differs. Add a tooltip and a link to the raw event log.
samir (metering): I'll submit a patch to increase dedupe TTL to 180s in canary for 48h to reduce immediate duplicates. If we see memory >5% we'll roll back.
maya (eng-platform): Great. Luis, can you add the suppression rule to the preview alerting config? Something like:
```
if preview_delta_pct < 0.5 and fingerprint_overlap > 1:
  severity = "info"
  show_in_console("low-confidence: overlapping samples", link=events_url)
else:
  normal_alert()
```
luis (analytics): On it. I'll also add a small per-tenant note in the invoice-preview UI.
ingest-bot: canary-deploy: metering-dedupe-ttl -> 180s (canary group 3) has been deployed to us-west-2.
samir (metering): Thanks. I'll watch the canary metrics and post a short follow-up in this thread. If canary looks good we'll promote.
maya (eng-platform): Action items: samir -> canary TTL change + monitor, luis -> console suppression rule + UI note, ira -> confirm CS messaging, maya -> follow up on pipeline long-term dedupe design. Ping me if anything spikes. :thumbsup:
